Remark
[compactness for kappa solutions] Source: kleiner-lott ↗ cor:kl-two-dimensional-solutions-kappa-solutions-corollary 1. Remark 46.4\group Kleiner–Lott Kappa Solutions

The Ricci-flow hypothesis supplies compactness of the limiting nonnegatively curved surface through the two-dimensional classification; this is not automatic for a merely noncollapsed Riemannian manifold.
